conclusion: 今天没有比 9 月 6 日更晚的 Codex 稳定版、Copilot CLI 稳定版或 OpenAI Node SDK 发布。新增可确认信号是 Codex 0.154.0-alpha.4 预发布占位，但它没有行为说明，因此只能进入 alpha 观察 lane，不能据此调整生产默认。真正值得收口的是模型生命周期和策略执行层: Copilot 模型退役、Gemini 3.8 Flash 渐进 rollout、企业与团队默认模型、内容排除、预算到期、AI review approval、Actions provenance、CodeQL workflow pinning 和 npm OIDC staged publishing 都开始提供更细的政策与证据字段。
excerpt: 2026-09-07 的重点是模型退役迁移、默认模型策略、上下文排除、CI provenance 和 staged OIDC 发布闸门。
今天的判断很明确: 旧模型要提前办交接，默认模型要现场点名，敏感文件要前后两次检查，CI 和发布都要留下真实执行者的小票。

signals.title: Codex 0.154.0-alpha.4 published as a prerelease placeholder
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: The public release page exposes 0.154.0-alpha.4, but the body contains only the release label and no behavioral notes.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Keep 0.154 in an isolated alpha lane and wait for detailed notes before changing defaults or acceptance criteria.

signals.title: Copilot CLI 1.0.83-4 adds MCP OAuth CIMD and safer session resume defaults
signals.author: GitHub / GitHub Releases
signals.summary: The prerelease adds MCP OAuth Client ID Metadata Document support, starts without interrupted-session restore by default, and improves large-session responsiveness.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Keep prerelease behavior isolated and record client identity, resume policy, and transcript state before upgrading.

signals.title: Copilot CLI 1.0.83-5 blocks sandboxed localhost access by default
signals.author: GitHub / GitHub Releases
signals.summary: On macOS and Linux, sandboxed commands cannot reach local services or a server started on 127.0.0.1; Linux dependencies are explicit.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Classify localhost test failures as a network-boundary result and require explicit Allow local network approval for exceptions.

signals.title: OpenAI Node SDK 7.9.0 updates usage APIs and WebSocket redirect handling
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: The SDK updates usage APIs, prevents Responses WebSockets from following redirects, and fixes browser/CommonJS and Jest 28 compatibility.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Pin SDK versions and rerun telemetry, browser-bundle, and long-connection tests before upgrading.

signals.title: GitHub schedules selected Copilot model retirements for October 2
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Kimi K2.7 Code, and Claude Opus 4.7 are scheduled for Copilot retirement on 2026-10-02 with suggested replacements.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Inventory retiring model keys, migrate fallbacks and policies, and run fixed regression tasks before the cutoff.

signals.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash rolls out across GitHub Copilot surfaces
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Gemini 3.8 Flash is listed for VS Code, Visual Studio, Copilot CLI, cloud agent, app, JetBrains, Xcode, and Eclipse, with gradual rollout and policy controls.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Read back model availability per surface and record introductory pricing expiry instead of assuming synchronized access.

signals.title: Enterprise-managed settings can choose any default Copilot model
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Business and Enterprise admins can set a default model for new conversations and override it by enterprise team in the app, CLI, and VS Code.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Version enterprise default, team overrides, model policy, and observed client model together.

signals.title: Content exclusions are generally available in Copilot app and CLI
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Copilot app and CLI honor enterprise, organization, and repository exclusion policies and do not use excluded files as context.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Maintain an exclusion contract by policy level and verify policy readback plus the public output boundary.

signals.title: GitHub Actions adds runner deprecation and workflow provenance controls
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Actions adds a runner deprecation API, read-only vulnerability-alerts permission, and job fields for the actual reusable workflow source.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Record runner deadlines, minimize GITHUB_TOKEN scopes, and store job.workflow_* in agent CI receipts.

signals.title: npm supports multiple trusted publishing configurations per package
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Stable, prerelease, and staging workflows can use separate additive OIDC configurations, while staged approval waits for malware scanning.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Default OIDC lanes to staging, audit overlapping additive matches, and require scan completion plus human approval.

signals.title: CodeQL 2.26.4 strengthens GitHub Actions security detections
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: CodeQL detects mutable references to reusable workflows and tightens actor-field and environment-check reasoning, which may surface new alerts.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Pin reusable workflows to immutable SHAs and review new alerts as analysis updates.

signals.title: GitHub CLI Linux package signing key rollover reaches its cutoff
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: APT and RPM metadata after September 5 use the replacement key; old Linux images or setup scripts may fail while macOS and Homebrew installs are unaffected.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Verify CI images trust the replacement key before diagnosing gh install failures as application regressions.

signals.title: Copilot code review can submit policy-controlled approvals
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Approval assessment appears in every review, while formal approval is off by default and policy-controlled with path limits.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Keep assessment, comments, formal approval, required approval, and post-commit dismissal as separate states.

signals.title: Individual Copilot budgets can expire automatically
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Business and Enterprise admins can expire temporary user budget overrides on a billing date or specific date through settings or expires_at.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Give experiments expiring budgets and include expires_at, fallback budget, and renewal owner in receipts.

signals.title: Claude Fable 5.1 adds a model-specific retention gate in Copilot
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Claude Fable 5.1 targets long-horizon work but requires data retention by default; zero-retention access is limited to eligible approved enterprises.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Record retention mode, zero-retention eligibility, admin enablement, plan, pricing, and surface before sensitive work.

signals.title: GitHub CLI can attach local media to issues and pull requests
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: gh 2.99.0 adds repeatable --attach for images and videos in issue and PR create, edit, and comment commands.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Inspect media, remove private metadata, confirm repository scope, and require alt text before upload.

signals.title: Copilot Business and Enterprise card signups reopen with upfront seat billing
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Credit-card and PayPal signups reopen gradually, with payment required before new seat access and upfront seat charging from October 1.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Separate account availability from capability and record seat timing, included usage, and excess-payment behavior.

signals.title: Kit by Speakeasy advertises a coding-agent runtime
signals.author: Speakeasy / Product Hunt
signals.summary: Product Hunt RSS describes Kit as a faster, cheaper, concise coding-agent runtime; the item is a candidate, not an established capability claim.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Trial only with synthetic work after checking data access, routing, retention, writes, billing, and rollback.

signals.title: Blume.codes proposes turning coding sessions into rules and skills
signals.author: Blume.codes / Product Hunt
signals.summary: Product Hunt RSS claims it converts coding-agent sessions into better rules and skills, which may capture sensitive transcripts.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Use synthetic sessions and verify local processing, redaction, retention, generated-rule review, and opt-out.

signals.title: Hyperprobe proposes production debugging without redeploying
signals.author: Hyperprobe / Product Hunt
signals.summary: Product Hunt RSS positions Hyperprobe as a way for agents to debug production without redeployment, a high-privilege observability pattern.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Require read-only synthetic evaluation, payload redaction, query allowlists, audit logs, and no-fix-in-production.

knowledge.title: Model Retirement Migration Gate
knowledge.label: MODEL LIFECYCLE
knowledge.body: 盘点退役模型、截止日、替代模型、管理员启用状态和固定回归证据，完成迁移后再切默认。
knowledge.summary: 把模型退役当成有截止日、替代方案和回归证据的迁移项目。
steps: 盘点 model key、fallback、prompt 模板和 policy。
记录截止日、替代模型、管理员启用状态和每个入口的 rollout。
用固定任务回归质量、工具、成本和 retention。
knowledge.risk: 替代模型在公告中存在，不等于组织已启用或客户端已可选。

knowledge.title: Default Model Policy Receipt
knowledge.label: DEFAULT POLICY
knowledge.body: 同时记录企业默认、团队覆盖、picker 状态和实际会话模型，防止策略静默漂移。
knowledge.summary: 同时记录企业默认、团队覆盖、picker 状态和实际会话模型。
steps: 保存 policy 版本、enterprise default、team override 和允许覆盖范围。
在每个入口创建新会话并读回实际模型。
knowledge.risk: 默认、可选和实际执行模型可能处于不同状态。

knowledge.title: Context Exclusion Contract
knowledge.label: CONTEXT BOUNDARY
knowledge.body: 用可审计路径清单限制 agent 输入，并在 diff、日志、附件和公开产物中再次检查。
knowledge.summary: 用可审计的路径清单限制 agent 输入，并在输出端再次检查。
steps: 记录 enterprise、organization、repository 各层排除路径与适用入口。
运行前读回 policy，禁止手工复制绕过排除。
运行后扫描 diff、日志、附件和公开产物。
knowledge.risk: 输入排除不保证模型输出或外部附件自动安全。

knowledge.title: Workflow Provenance Gate
knowledge.label: CI PROVENANCE
knowledge.body: 对 agent 触发的 CI 同时证明 runner 仍受支持、token 足够小、实际 workflow 来源可追溯。
knowledge.summary: 对 agent 触发的 CI 同时证明 runner、token 和实际 workflow 来源。
steps: 预查 runner registration 和 runtime deprecation 时间。
给 GITHUB_TOKEN 只开所需权限。
knowledge.risk: 只记录调用方 workflow 会漏掉真正执行的跨仓工作流。

knowledge.title: Staged OIDC Publishing Gate
knowledge.label: PUBLISHING
knowledge.body: 多发布入口分别使用 OIDC，但默认只进 staging，扫描完成后才由人批准。
knowledge.summary: 多发布入口分别使用 OIDC，但默认只进 staging，扫描完成后才由人批准。
steps: 为每个配置记录 repository、workflow、environment 和 direct publish 状态。
检查 additive 匹配是否重叠。
malware scan 完成前不开放批准，正式发布后读回 provenance。
knowledge.risk: 多配置减少长期 token，但也可能扩大可发布面。
